tiers.name: GRAND FEAST
tiers.tag: Koji has run out of cups.

text.idle: SHALL WE POUR? PLACE A BET

buys.name: Tin Rush
buys.text: Skip the tea break. The Tins drop right away and the Tin Rush starts with 3 pours. Fill the drawers, launch the kites.
buys.confirmText: TIN RUSH: six or more Tea Tins land and the hold-and-win round starts with 3 pours.

buys.name: Free Spins
buys.text: Three festival drums drop at once and Koji starts 10 free spins. Every drawer that helps a win steeps darker and pays more next time.
buys.confirmText: FREE SPINS: three FS drums land, then 10 free spins with Steeping Drawers (more spins from more drums).

buys.name: Super Free Spins
buys.text: Four drums, a golden dusk and four drawers already steeped. 12 free spins with the strongest drawer boosts. Wild swings.
buys.confirmText: SUPER FREE SPINS: four FS drums land, 12 spins, four drawers start pre-steeped, gold drawers pay the most. Very volatile.

intro.quote: "Kite weather! Shall we fill every drawer?"
chips: A NEW TIN RESETS THE POURS TO 3
FULL ROW: KITE LAUNCH, ROW x2

outro.label: YOUR HARVEST
outro.quote: "Thank you for visiting. Do come again."

fever.name: FS Luck
fever.text: Pay 3x per spin and the festival drums (FS) land 5 times as often as in the normal game, so Free Spins and Super Free Spins come far more often. Stays on until you switch it off.
fever.onMsg: FS LUCK ON. TOTAL BET x3

features.title: TIN RUSH
features.text: Buy your way in: the Tins drop and a hold-and-win round starts. Complete a row for the Kite Launch that doubles it, fill the board for the Grand Dragon Kite.

features.title: FREE SPINS
features.text: 3 FS drums give 10 free spins, 4 FS give the Super round. Every drawer that helps a win steeps and pays more next time.
